_This page is generated from src/checks/, so it says what the tool does._

A check is one object in the `checks` list of a `case.json`. Every check has a `type`, and takes an optional `weight`, a positive number that defaults to 1. [Write a case](../guides/write-a-case.md) shows how to use them.

## Check types

| Check                 | Fields                                                                                             | Scores 1 when                                                                                              |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `skill_loaded`        | `skill`                                                                                            | The agent loaded that skill.                                                                               |
| `skill_not_loaded`    | `skill`                                                                                            | The agent did not load that skill.                                                                         |
| `output_matches`      | `pattern`, optional `flags`                                                                        | The final answer matches the regular expression.                                                           |
| `output_lacks`        | `pattern`, optional `flags`                                                                        | The final answer does not match the regular expression.                                                    |
| `output_contains`     | `text`                                                                                             | The final answer contains that text.                                                                       |
| `output_not_contains` | `text`                                                                                             | The final answer does not contain that text.                                                               |
| `file_exists`         | `path`                                                                                             | That file exists in the workspace after the run.                                                           |
| `file_matches`        | `path`, `pattern`, optional `flags`                                                                | That file exists and matches the regular expression.                                                       |
| `tool_called`         | at least one of `kind`, `name`, optional `inputMatches`, optional `flags`                          | The agent made a tool call that fits every given field.                                                    |
| `tool_not_called`     | at least one of `kind`, `name`, optional `inputMatches`, optional `flags`                          | The agent made no tool call that fits every given field.                                                   |
| `subject_unchanged`   |                                                                                                    | The agent changed nothing in the copy of the subject that the run loaded.                                  |
| `judge`               | `rubric`                                                                                           | Not 0 or 1. A model scores the final answer against the rubric.                                            |
| `decision`            | `question`, optional `expect`, optional `options`. It takes exactly one of `expect` and `options`. | Not 0 or 1. A decision model gives each allowed answer a probability, and the score is the expected value. |

## Fields

| Field           | Type     | Holds                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `skill`         | `text`   | The name of a skill.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `pattern`       | `regex`  | A regular expression.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `text`          | `text`   | Text to look for. The match is exact and case-sensitive.                                                                                                                         |
| `path`          | `path`   | A file path inside the workspace.                                                                                                                                                |
| `kind`          | `kind`   | What the tool does, with the same word in every harness.                                                                                                                         |
| `name`          | `regex`  | A regular expression for the harness's own tool name.                                                                                                                            |
| `inputMatches`  | `regex`  | A regular expression for the tool call's input, written as JSON.                                                                                                                 |
| `flags`         | `flags`  | The flags of the check's regular expressions.                                                                                                                                    |
| `rubric`        | `text`   | Plain text that says what a good answer does.                                                                                                                                    |
| `question`      | `text`   | A question about the final answer.                                                                                                                                               |
| `expect`        | `enum`   | The answer that scores 1 for a yes or no question: "yes" or "no".                                                                                                                |
| `options`       | `object` | An object of at least two answers, each with a number from 0 to 1 that says what the answer is worth.                                                                            |
| `requires`      | `needs`  | A list of capabilities the check needs, such as `"mcp"`, or `"bin:<name>"` for an executable on the host's `PATH`. A harness that lacks one cannot run the check.                |
| `ifUnsupported` | `enum`   | What a harness that lacks what the check needs does: "skip" drops this check and re-normalizes the weights, "not-applicable" excludes the whole case. Default: "not-applicable". |

## Case file keys

The keys of a `case.json`. Any other key is a load error, except a key that starts with `x-`.

| Key              | Type     | Holds                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `checks`         | `object` | A non-empty list of checks.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `weight`         | `number` | How much the case counts in its suite. Default: 1.                                                                                                                             |
| `minScore`       | `unit`   | The lowest score the case may get and still pass.                                                                                                                              |
| `maxTurns`       | `int`    | The most turns the agent may take. Only Claude Code applies it.                                                                                                                |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `int`    | The seconds a run may take. Default: 600.                                                                                                                                      |
| `requires`       | `needs`  | A list of capabilities the case needs, such as `"mcp"`, or `"bin:<name>"` for an executable on the host's `PATH`. A harness that lacks one reports the case as not applicable. |
| `harnesses`      | `texts`  | The harness ids the case is for. Any other harness reports it as not applicable. Needs `note`. A last resort: prefer `requires`.                                               |
| `note`           | `text`   | Why the case is limited to `harnesses`. The report shows it.                                                                                                                   |

## Tool kinds

A `kind` is one of these words.

| Kind       | Meaning                                                              |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `shell`    | Ran a command.                                                       |
| `read`     | Read a file.                                                         |
| `write`    | Created or replaced a file.                                          |
| `edit`     | Changed part of a file, or deleted one.                              |
| `search`   | Searched or listed files.                                            |
| `web`      | Fetched a page or searched the web.                                  |
| `skill`    | Called the harness's skill tool.                                     |
| `subagent` | Started another agent.                                               |
| `other`    | Any tool the harness's adapter has no kind for, such as an MCP tool. |
